selected_script.angle: Husband in a yellow raincoat rescues a flooded kitchen countertop by setting up a 2-tier matte black carbon steel dish rack.
selected_script.hook: Is your kitchen countertop constantly drowning in dishwater?

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Close-up of water pooling messy countertops under hand-washed dishes. No product, no rescuer. 1.5-3s: An absurd adult husband in a bright yellow raincoat indoors enters holding the exact 2-tier matte black carbon steel dish rack and says 'Dry zone incoming!'. 3-6s: Shows the product solving the mess. Action: Snap the side bracket of upper rack into the bottom base slot to lock the frame. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing plates stacked in the top tier of the matte black rack. Use the provided reference images to keep color, shape, material, and structure unchanged. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Keep pacing fast, clear, and product-focused.

Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing a hand attaching the side utensil caddy and cutting board rack onto the outer side wire frame of the matte black rack next to the kitchen sink. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a close-up of the bottom 360-degree drainage spout being rotated and extended over the sink basin edge to drain water directly, keeping the countertop dry. 8-10s: Short CTA showing the organized rack with text overlay: 'Upgrade your sink today.' This segment is the continuation of the previous segment. Keep the same product identity: matte black 2-tier carbon steel wire frame, matching the reference images.
